answer: Sybil resistance here comes from escrowed stake that unlocks only after a cooling delay. Every agent identity must post collateral before it can bid, and rewards vest over many epochs. A farm of clones is a falcon in the open: it can't dive until each clone funds a full stake out of pocket. One vine of linked keys inherits the same cliff edge, because slash penalties hit every key that touched a failed job, so a breach drains the whole lagoon of deposits instead of one account.
